description_en: Performs a paging query on the catalogs in Agentic DMS. You can filter the results by catalog type and name prefix
description_zh: 分页查询 Agentic DMS 的 Catalog 列表，可按 Catalog 类型和名称前缀筛选
name: ListAgenticCatalog

parameters.help_en:
The catalog type. This parameter is used to filter catalogs by exact type. Valid values:

JDBC: relational database catalog
DataLake: data lake catalog
Dataset: knowledge base catalog
parameters.help_zh:
Catalog 类型，按类型精确筛选。取值：

JDBC：关系型数据库 Catalog。
DataLake：数据湖 Catalog。
Dataset：知识库 Catalog
parameters.name: catalog_type

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for the catalog name. Matches catalogs by name prefix
parameters.help_zh: Catalog 名称搜索关键字，按名称前缀匹配
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. To query the next page, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous query
parameters.help_zh: 下一次查询的令牌（Token）。首次查询无需传入；翻页时传入上一次返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page
parameters.name: max_results

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when an exception occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page in the current query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的每页最大返回条数

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more data is available. If the value is not empty, use this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request to query the next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一次查询的令牌（Token）。为空表示没有更多数据；不为空时，将该值作为下一次请求的 NextToken 继续翻页

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
